result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions, so pkgdown/Doxygen/meta-generator `.htm` pages, `.NET` `<doc>` XML files, `// Generated by` JavaScript files and `build-gradle.js` now match. The new test and the related existing tests pass offline. Nothing is committed.

Changes, all in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/`:

- **`GeneratedConventions.java`**
  - The three generated-HTML rules (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator) now use `.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)`. The old pattern listed `html` twice and never had `htm`.
  - The .NET XML rule path changed from `.*/[.]xml` to `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.
  - The JS `// Generated by` rule path changed from `.*/[.]js` to `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- **`BuildAndDeploymentConventions.java`**: the Gradle JS rule path changed from `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` to `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/DefaultConventionsTest.java`. It checks the positive cases from the task, the existing matches (Doxygen `.html`, `.xhtml` with a generator tag, `build.gradle`), and negative cases for hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files.

Tests run with `mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test`: `DefaultConventionsTest` and `SourceFileFilterTest`, then `CodeConfigurationTest`, `*Convention*` and `*Scop*`. All passed.
